reuse.why: Builds on the existing isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories selection and drops the 'all' scope so setZero uses it too; the template exclusion uses an extra query rather than going into the existing predicate.

duplication.why: The template exclusion (fetch templated ids, test membership) is applied twice, once in getMonthFillCategories and again in copyPreviousMonth, next to the shared predicate.

placement.why: The hidden rule lives in the shared predicate, but the template rule sits beside it in two callers instead of inside isMonthFillCategory, with goal_def added to the queries that feed it.

scope.why: Only the month-wide selection, setZero's scope and tests are changed.

maintainability.why: A maintainer has to know that 'which categories a month-wide action fills' is split between isMonthFillCategory and a separate templatedIds set that each caller must remember to apply.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts applies its own templatedIds check after isMonthFillCategory, and getMonthFillCategories does the same, rather than the predicate deciding the template rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated template check is an open, near-identical copy in two places rather than a reshaped one.

one_place.where: Hidden category/group exclusion is decided once in isMonthFillCategory, but the saved-template exclusion is decided separately in getMonthFillCategories and in copyPreviousMonth via getTemplatedCategoryIds.
